name: ahaslides-design
description: The AhaSlides design system's own agent entry point, shipped and versioned with each ahaslides-design release. One skill, aha-design, reads the DS (the installed @ahaslides-product/design package or its hosted feeds: llms.txt, the anti-slop feed, guidelines) and runs the build -> judge -> fix loop against the DS anti-slop criteria for each surface. Hooks make it fire: a prompt mandate on every task, a write-time guard that names the DS surface a change touches (and blocks the old storybook kit in new Vue 2 files, a hand-made icon: an inline <svg> or a new .svg file, pointing at the DS icon search, and a raw <button> or <aha-button size="xl"> added to a build-less slide type's presenter or audience file), an end-of-turn judge trigger and an anti-slop floor, both of which also cover a build-less slide type's presenter / audience / settings .html and .js files. Hooks read criteria from the installed package, else the copy shipped in this plugin from the same release. Covers every AhaSlides tool people operate; marketing / brand surfaces are aha-marketing-skills.
